task.title: Make Qlib adapter activation-ready behind gate
task.summary_zh: 把 Qlib 從 smoke/draft adapter 補到 activation-ready：資料門檻、模型 artifact、checksum、registry candidate packet 與 gateway execution 都要可跑；預設仍 fail-closed。
acceptance: Qlib enabled path uses a real backend or explicit install error not silent stub
production data floors are enforced before run
model artifacts persist with checksum and metadata
registry candidate packet is generated without direct registry write
gateway qlib run succeeds under explicit offline gate and fails closed by default
task.next: Finalized Qlib activation-ready adapter in task-scoped commit a61b57c. Verification: 28 qlib unit tests OK; qlib smoke_test OK; 11 gateway activation/dispatch tests OK; 9 gateway rejection/http tests OK. Offline Qlib path remains explicit-gate only and production/paper/canary/live remain fail-closed.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過，所有 5 項驗收標準均已核實：Qlib 後端缺失時明確 install error、production data floors 預設強制、checksum 正確的 artifact/registry/candidate 已持久化、candidate packet 為非寫入且 registry_write_authority=registry_service_only、gateway 預設 fail-closed 且 open-gate 路徑通過。28 unit tests + smoke test + 11 gateway tests 全部通過。

handoffs.message: Ready for review: Qlib activation-ready offline adapter now has explicit worker env gate, explicit backend selection with real-backend install error, activation data-floor enforcement, persisted artifact/registry/candidate handoff files, non-writing candidate packet, and gateway closed/open gate tests. Verified: python3 services/research/qlib/smoke_test.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s services/research/qlib -p 'test_*.py'; pytest -q services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_qlib_activation.py services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_gate_dispatch.py services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_rejection_policy.py; pytest -q services/research-worker-gateway/tests/test_research_worker_gateway_http_service.py. Production/paper/canary/live and registry writes remain fail-closed.

Review approved and returned to Codex for finalization. All 5 acceptance criteria verified: explicit QlibWorkflowError on missing backend install, production data floors enforced by default in worker.py, checksum-bearing artifact/registry/candidate handoff files persisted by persist_qlib_run_artifacts(), non-writing candidate packet with registry_write_authority=registry_service_only, and gateway fail-closed by default with open-gate offline execution confirmed. Evidence: 28 unit tests OK, smoke_test OK, 11 gateway activation+dispatch tests OK, 9 rejection/http tests OK. Production/paper/canary/live remain fail-closed.
